extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF figure captions, mechanism results text, methods, and supplementary captions; claims are bounded to the actual evidence class.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP1 rapidly enters B. subtilis cells and accumulates intracellularly; membrane depolarization is gradual rather than an immediate detergent-like lysis claim.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct evidence supports cell entry and delayed depolarization; it does not support a claim of instantaneous membrane rupture as the primary mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP1-treated B. subtilis cells show abnormal binary fission and damaged cell-wall morphology, supporting a cell-wall-integrity phenotype while keeping cell-wall synthesis inhibition as a hypothesis.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper does not identify a molecular enzyme target in the cell-wall pathway; final curation must keep the claim at phenotype-supported mechanism level.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MD simulations and Trp-to-Leu mutant experiments support selective interaction with anionic bacterial-mimicking membranes and reduced intracellular stability for AMP1-2L.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MD results support membrane selectivity and residue-function context, but are not alone treated as direct cellular target proof.
